# Coursera DL

> High-performance cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri v2, Rust, and React to download enrolled Coursera courses, HD videos, lecture slides, and multilingual subtitles for offline personal study.

Coursera DL is a free, fast, and open-source desktop tool designed for personal backup and offline learning preservation.

## Key Features & Authentication
- **1-Click Direct Coursera Login**: Seamless embedded login window for regular users. Automatically detects and authenticates your `CAUTH` session cookie.
- **Manual Cookie Login for Power Users**: Power users can optionally export and paste their `CAUTH` session cookie directly.
- **Privacy & Local Security**: Zero credentials or passwords stored. All cookies remain strictly on your local machine with zero external backend servers. 100% open-source and auditable.
- **1080p & 720p Video Downloads**: High-speed chunk-based streaming with multi-stream resilience.
- **Subtitles & PDF Slides**: Downloads multilingual VTT/SRT captions and full lecture slides/notes.
- **Batch Specialization Discovery**: 1-click batch discovery and downloading for complete programs.
